explanation: Guy's remark, quoted on the page, is 'there may be only finitely many k-perfect numbers with k ≥ 3'. The formalization reads this per k: for each fixed k ≥ 3 the set of k-perfect numbers is finite. The word 'even' in Guy's sentence suggests the stronger reading that the set of all n with σ(n) = kn for some k ≥ 3 is finite. The Lean statement is a weaker, still-open claim, which is reasonable but may not capture the suggestion as intended. Stating the union version as well, or instead, would be more faithful.
